end.summary:
Identified standing, sleeping, and slanting lines using familiar examples.
Practised telling straight lines from curved lines.
Recognised that all three line directions can be straight.
Initially questioned whether a tilted line is straight; corrected this later.
Teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Om practised identifying standing, sleeping, and slanting lines, and separating straight lines from curved lines. Using examples such as a goalpost, slide, and leaning wall, Asha helped them correct the mix-up that a tilted line can still be straight; this was corrected later in the lesson. At home, ask Om to find one standing, one sleeping, and one slanting straight line in the room, then trace a curved object such as a bangle.
